statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness accompanied by transient neurological symptoms suggestive of a transient cerebral ischemic attack.
The patient has a history of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia (I49.9).
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered.
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197.
The denial was because required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The diagnosis codes submitted are G45.9, I49.9, and R42.
